metadata.description: Lantern: one illustration and interface style in many colours, as installable skills.

plugins.name: lantern
plugins.description: Lantern, a design system for illustrated slides, cut-away machines and buildings, close-up portrait scenes, annotated figures, title and break slides, GIF/MP4 loops and a small UI kit with code tokens, in one style across many colour themes (Black, Blue, Cyan, Gold, Gray, Green, Orange, Purple, Red, Rose, Teal, White, and any colour added from a brand colour), each with a 50-950 shade ramp, dark and light variants, seven type sets and many languages.

plugins.name: lantern-blue
plugins.description: Lantern Blue: illustrated slides, cut-away machines and buildings, close-up portrait scenes, annotated concept figures, title and break slides, seamless GIF/MP4 loops, and a small UI kit with code tokens, in the Blue colour theme (night-navy ground, one amber light, grain, silhouette figures, glowing flow lines), in dark or light with seven type sets.
